kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نمتنع (form VIII)
# نَمْتَنِعُ (namtaniʕu) /nam.ta.ni.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
# نُمْتَنَعُ (numtanaʕu) /num.ta.na.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
# نَمْتَنِعَ (namtaniʕa) /nam.ta.ni.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
# نُمْتَنَعَ (numtanaʕa) /num.ta.na.ʕa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
